# CultureWithGen

> Intercultural communication and collaboration training for multicultural workplaces and international business, run by Genevieve Navisotschnig from Austria. Practical, discussion-based workshops are delivered in English, in-company or online, and are tailored to each organisation. The website is a bilingual (English/German) single-page site; this file summarises what the service is and who it is for.

CultureWithGen helps international teams and local staff communicate and collaborate effectively across cultures. Workshops use real-life examples, workplace situations and interactive activities so that participants leave with communication and collaboration skills they can apply immediately.

All workshops are delivered in English. Drawing on a background as a Business English trainer, the trainer adapts language and delivery to participants' English proficiency levels, so mixed-fluency groups can take part on equal footing.

Topics covered:

- Communication and collaboration in multicultural teams
- Working effectively with international colleagues and clients
- Understanding different communication styles and cultural perspectives
- Developing cultural awareness and intercultural competence

Who it is for:

- Multicultural teams
- Organisations operating internationally
- Professionals working with international colleagues or clients
- Teams seeking to strengthen collaboration and navigate cultural differences

Situations workshops typically address:

- Communication styles are interpreted in different ways
- Expectations around roles and responsibilities vary
- Ways of working and approaches to feedback vary
- Approaches to decision-making create uncertainty
- Misunderstandings impact teamwork

Formats: in-company training, online workshops, half-day or full-day sessions. Individual sessions or a series of training sessions can be arranged.

Trainer: Genevieve Navisotschnig, an intercultural trainer working in higher education and with companies, with experience of living and working in different countries. Qualifications: Master's degree in Adult Learning in Global Change, Postgraduate Diploma in Intercultural Competence, Bachelor's degree in Psychology and Sociology.

Location and availability: based in Austria (Neumarkt am Wallersee, Salzburg). Workshops are available on-site at the client's premises and online, so delivery is not limited to Austria.

Enquiries: via the contact section of the website, which lists the email address.
